Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in traffic at a signal on a Houston arterial road when the rear of the vehicle was struck by Driver
2's pickup, which was following too closely. Driver 1 was operating a sedan and reported neck pain and stiffness
consistent with whiplash shortly after the impact. Passenger was seated in the front right position and was also in the
vehicle at the time of the collision. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the general location and position of both
vehicles, and the rear bumper damage on Driver 1's car appears generally consistent with the reported force of the
impact. No independent witnesses were identified who observed the collision itself. Driver 1 is listed as a named
insured on the policy covering the sedan. Officers found no indication of prior damage to the rear of the vehicle, and
the rpeorted injuries appear to match the type and force of this crash. Driver 2 was issued a citation for following too
closely.
